name: Gulfport
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Gulfport, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Gulfport, Florida for 2026: a community parade, a boat parade, a tree lighting, Breakfast with Santa and a library movie night.
lede: Gulfport brings a small town Christmas to the waterfront with a community parade, a lighted boat parade, a tree lighting at Clymer Park and Santa breakfast.
celebrates: The City of Gulfport anchors the season at Clymer Park and along Beach Boulevard South. Its community holiday parade on December 12 brings floats and marching bands, followed by a Santa photo at the city tree. The tree lighting on December 7 features local children's programs and a visit from Santa, and Gulfport Public Library offers a family Christmas movie and pajama party on December 11. The Boca Ciega Yacht Club adds a lighted boat parade the evening of December 12.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Gulfport's holiday events, so this page relies on the City of Gulfport's own 2026 pages. The Boca Ciega Yacht Club describes its boat parade as the 40th annual, which makes it one of the longest running holiday traditions in the area.
facts: The Boca Ciega Yacht Club boat parade is its 40th annual and supports Operation Santa. Gulfport's city tree stands at the Clymer Park Pavilion, and the city lists spectator parking at the Gulfport Public Library and the Catherine A. Hickman Theater for the parade.
trains: Gulfport has no holiday train of its own. The nearest is the Rudolph Limited at the Largo Central Railroad, which runs December 11 to 13, 18 to 20 and 26 and 27, 2026, according to the City of Largo; see our Largo events for details.
traditions: The City of Gulfport's December 12 parade along Beach Boulevard South with floats and marching bands.
Boca Ciega Yacht Club Boat Parade
The 40th annual lighted boat parade, December 12, free to watch.
The December 7 tree lighting at Clymer Park with local children's programs and Santa.
The December 5 breakfast at Boca Ciega High School hosted by the St. Petersburg Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta.
kidfact: Gulfport's holiday parade ends with a Santa photo at the city Christmas tree in Clymer Park.
faq: The city holds a community holiday parade on December 12 with floats and marching bands, a tree lighting at Clymer Park on December 7 and a family movie night at the library on December 11. The Boca Ciega Yacht Club adds a lighted boat parade on December 12.
Is the Gulfport holiday parade free?
Yes, public parades are free to watch. The city lists parking at the library and the Hickman Theater.
Where can kids meet Santa in Gulfport?
Santa appears at the tree lighting on December 7, in a community photo after the parade on December 12 and at Breakfast with Santa on December 5.
Yes. The Boca Ciega Yacht Club Holiday Boat Parade is free to watch, December 12 from 6 to 8:30 pm.
sources: Community news: tree lighting and library events
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Gulfport for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from Breakfast with Santa in Gulfport (December 5) through the Gulfport Community Holiday Parade and the Boca Ciega Yacht Club Holiday Boat Parade (both December 12), with the City of Gulfport Holiday Tree Lighting at Clymer Park (December 7) and the Family Christmas Movie and Pajama Party at the library (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Gulfport

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Gulfport
  • 2 free events: the Gulfport Community Holiday Parade and the Boca Ciega Yacht Club Holiday Boat Parade
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa in Gulfport (December 5), the Santa photo after the parade (December 12) and the tree lighting (December 7)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Community Holiday Parade (December 12), Boat Parade (December 12) and the Clymer Park Tree Lighting (December 7)
  • Trains: none in town; see the Largo page for the Rudolph Limited
  • Season: December 5 to December 12
